decisions.reason: The height-adjustable executive desk system fits the firm's office focus, flexibility trend, and was given strong standalone presentation, so it is very likely to be retained.
A chair family is close to the firm's core premium seating offer and its dedicated web presence suggests it is an important line worth developing further.

Floor cushions from carpets are more niche and accessory-like than the firm's main premium furniture lines, so they are the most plausible candidate to be discontinued and free resources for stronger core products.
A soft upholstered sofa fits the firm's living and lounge positioning well, and despite lower web emphasis it still aligns with the core collection.
The high standing table matches contemporary workplace and conference needs and supports the firm's move toward adaptable interiors, making continuation likely.
The rug collection is somewhat distant from the established offer, but its own product page and relevance for complete interior solutions make it worth keeping for now.
